name: Paris
about: Late spring and early fall are the sweet spot. Summer is hot and packed (some small restaurants close mid-August); winter is grey but atmospheric, with Christmas markets.
overview: Museums, architecture, and food worth planning a trip around, all within walking distance or a short métro ride of each other.
costOverview: A quick baguette sandwich barely registers; taxis and landmark tickets are what actually add up.

specialSeasons.text: Christmas markets and holiday lights fill the city, especially along the Champs-Élysées.
